title: Adaptive feature delivery
goal: Turn an ambiguous product idea into a verified release using only the capabilities and gates the risk requires.

nodes.title: Define the outcome
nodes.goal: Record the user outcome, scope, constraints, risks, and measurable acceptance criteria.
acceptanceChecks: The goal describes a user outcome rather than an implementation
Acceptance criteria are observable

nodes.title: Explore system taste and current design ideas
nodes.goal: Study existing Framework decisions, dated trend evidence, accessibility, performance, and two or three isolated design directions.
acceptanceChecks: Every trend has a source and capture date
Alternatives preserve accepted Framework decisions
Accessibility and performance costs are stated

nodes.title: Research implementation, security, and privacy
nodes.goal: Trace current architecture and gather current primary-source evidence for technical, security, privacy, and compatibility decisions.
acceptanceChecks: Current code paths and contracts are cited
Privacy and security claims use current primary sources
Compatibility boundaries are explicit

nodes.title: Benchmark the user workflow
nodes.goal: Compare task completion, language, friction, and error recovery with relevant tools and existing TechiesTools behavior.
acceptanceChecks: Comparisons use equivalent user tasks
Findings distinguish observation from preference

nodes.title: Synthesize a direction
nodes.goal: Combine design, technical, and UX evidence into a recommendation with objections, alternatives, and explicit trade-offs.
acceptanceChecks: Recommendation traces to evidence
Strongest objection and credible alternative are included

nodes.title: Approve the direction
nodes.goal: Let the product owner approve or reject the proposed direction before additional design work.
acceptanceChecks: Decision records approver and rationale

nodes.title: Prototype the approved direction
nodes.goal: Build isolated throwaway variants that answer the approved product and design questions without mutating production Framework behavior.
acceptanceChecks: Each variant answers the same question
Prototype-only state is isolated
Rendered behavior is captured

nodes.title: Promote one prototype
nodes.goal: Choose one outcome for production implementation or reject all variants.
acceptanceChecks: Decision names the selected outcome and rationale
Losing variants remain outside production

nodes.title: Implement the promoted outcome
nodes.goal: Integrate the selected behavior across UI, persistence, Preview, compilation, export, and generated artifacts where applicable.
acceptanceChecks: Tests fail before the implementation and pass afterward
All affected product surfaces agree
No prototype-only switchers or state remain

nodes.title: Verify functional and edge behavior
nodes.goal: Exercise real routes, breakpoints, keyboard paths, invalid inputs, persistence, output parity, and failure recovery.
acceptanceChecks: Acceptance criteria and edge cases are exercised
Failures include reproducible evidence

nodes.title: Verify UX against benchmarks
nodes.goal: Measure whether representative users can understand and complete the target task with acceptable friction.
acceptanceChecks: Tests use the original target task
Results compare against the recorded baseline

nodes.title: Review security and privacy
nodes.goal: Verify the implemented trust boundaries, data handling, permissions, dependencies, and relevant current requirements.
acceptanceChecks: Threats and mitigations map to actual code paths
Unresolved high-risk findings block release

nodes.title: Run fail-closed independent review
nodes.goal: Review the exact current diff and all test evidence without relying on implementation self-report.
acceptanceChecks: Review targets final HEAD
Blocking findings are fixed or explicitly rejected with evidence

nodes.title: Approve release
nodes.goal: Confirm the goal, acceptance criteria, evidence, and independent review are satisfied before promotion.
acceptanceChecks: Final HEAD passes required quality gates
No unresolved release blocker remains
